name: forecast-with-calibration
job: Produce calibrated probabilistic forecasts with resolvable question contracts, base rates, transparent aggregation, and proper scoring.

inScope: Making the question resolvable with deadline and resolution source
Establishing reference class and base rates before case details
Updating with policy, resolving against the predeclared source, and scoring
outOfScope: Combining forecasts with value and risk to choose an action (decision-quality)
Manufacturing precise probabilities from prose alone

inputs: Forecast question, horizon, and resolution source
outputs: Probabilistic Forecast Record with question contract and decomposition
Resolution, proper score, and calibration learning
failureSemantics: Ranges or insufficient-evidence exposure replace unsupported precision; correlated agreement is not independent evidence; a single forecast is never judged only by whether it happened, but by process, proper score, and calibration.

outcome.observable: A Probabilistic Forecast Record with a resolvable question contract, base-rate anchored probability or distribution, transparent history, and a proper-score resolution an independent scorer can reproduce.
